_comment: Example local override file for address labels. Copy to a private location, fill in your case/org attribution data, and point SUI_LABELS_FILE at it. Entries here override the shipped src/data/labeled-addresses.json for matching addresses. Same schema. Address keys may be short (0x2) or full 32-byte hex — they are normalized on load.
